title: Next thirty move envelopes
goal: Complete the next-thirty machinen move envelope ladder by proving explicit same-Machinen-Debian-base, cross-architecture, target-native continuation envelopes and fail-closed gatekeepers without claiming generic process, VM, ELF, Node, Python, Go, Rust, or runtime restore.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove support envelope 8A: cp SRC DST regular-file copy continues target-native from captured input and output offsets, using explicit cpState, an original target cp loader strategy, and final byte-for-byte target output evidence.
proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 33 tests, 368ms); local matrix cp-offset passed with cpState offsets, strategy target-original-cp-offset-loader, and final target cmp=match.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove gatekeeper envelope 8B: unsafe cp shapes refuse before target launch, including recursive copies, symlinks, devices, sparse-file ambiguity, and overwrite ambiguity.
proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 34 tests, 380ms); local matrix unsafe-cp-refusal passed with save/load refused, cpState=null, native continuation refused, and loaderStarted=false.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove support envelope 8C: mv SRC DST same-filesystem regular-file rename is accepted only at a pre-mutation boundary and target-native load produces exactly the target rename result.
proofChecklist.evidence: Local matrix mv-rename passed with pre-mutation ptrace capture, mvState /tmp/mv.in to /tmp/mv.out, strategy target-original-mv-rename-loader, and target destination content mv-proof-content.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove gatekeeper envelope 8D: unsafe mv shapes refuse before target launch, including cross-device moves, existing destination overwrite, directories, and symlinks.
proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 37 tests, 385ms); local matrix unsafe-mv-refusal passed with save/load refused, mvState=null, native continuation refused, and loaderStarted=false.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove support envelope 8E: sort FILE uses a deterministic input descriptor and target-original sort loader/recompute strategy, with target output matching expected sorted content.
proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 39 tests, 381ms); local matrix sort-file passed with sortState.path=/tmp/sort.in, strategy target-original-sort-file-loader, and target output alpha, alpha, bravo, charlie, zulu.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove gatekeeper envelope 8F: unsafe sort shapes refuse before target launch, including temp directory pressure, custom collation/locale ambiguity, and output path equal to input path.
proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 40 tests, 384ms); local matrix unsafe-sort-refusal passed with save/load refused, sortState=null, native continuation refused, and loaderStarted=false.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove support envelope 8G: wc -l FILE uses a deterministic completed-result continuation/recompute descriptor and target-original wc proof output matches expected line count.
proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 42 tests, 417ms); local matrix wc-line passed with wcState.path=/tmp/wc.in, mode lines, strategy target-original-wc-line-loader, and target output 4 /tmp/wc.in.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove gatekeeper envelope 8H: unsafe wc shapes refuse before target launch, including stdin pipes, changing files, and non-regular files.
proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 43 tests, 383ms); local matrix unsafe-wc-refusal passed with save/load refused, wcState=null, native continuation refused, and loaderStarted=false.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove support envelope 8I: sha256sum FILE uses a deterministic target recompute descriptor and target-original sha256sum output matches the expected digest.
proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 45 tests, 388ms) before digest tightening and 46 tests after; local matrix sha256sum-file passed with sha256State.path=/tmp/sha256.in, expectedDigest=ffd6cd2894e292d4fb55b643a8e3e3710a28a63ae4210495948211423bd71dc2, strategy target-original-sha256sum-file-loader, and matching target digest output.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove gatekeeper envelope 8J: unsafe checksum shapes refuse before target launch, including stdin input, multiple files, and changed file identity.
proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 46 tests, 384ms); local matrix unsafe-sha256sum-refusal passed with stdin save/load refused and sha256State=null, plus changed target identity load refused with loader state refused, no target pid, and changed-input-identity refusal before target checksum process launch.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove support envelope 9A: python3 -m http.server --directory DIR PORT recreates an idle target-native listener and serves files from the explicit directory.
proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 48 tests, 370ms); local matrix python-http-directory passed with httpState.directory=/tmp/web-directory, cwd=/, port 8128, strategy target-original-python-http-server-loader, and target response hello-http-directory.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove gatekeeper envelope 9B: Python HTTP with active request body or partial response refuses before target launch or before a ready loader claim.
proofChecklist.evidence: Local matrix python-http-active-refusal passed with active/partial client request: save accepted false, load accepted false, httpState=null, and loaderStarted=false.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove support envelope 9C: proof-provisioned busybox httpd -f -p PORT -h DIR recreates an idle target-native listener and serves files when available/provisioned.
proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 50 tests, 375ms after port fix); local matrix busybox-httpd passed with proof-provisioned BusyBox, busyboxHttpState.port=8134, root=/tmp/busybox-web, strategy target-original-busybox-httpd-loader, and target response hello-busybox-httpd.

proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 56 tests, 383ms); local matrix env-python-http-directory passed with envState.value=wrapped-http, child strategy target-original-python-http-server-loader, target response hello-env-http, and target /proc/$pid/environ containing MACHINEN_MOVE_ENV_PROOF=wrapped-http.

proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 57 tests, 387ms); local matrix unsupported-env-wrapper-refusal passed with save/load refused, envState=null, httpState=null, and loaderStarted=false.

proofChecklist.evidence: Local matrix node-static-http passed with explicit nodeStaticHttpState, strategy target-original-node-static-http-loader, and target health response ok.

proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 64 tests, 379ms); local matrix node-timer-refusal passed with save/load refused, nodeStaticHttpState=null, and loaderStarted=false.

proofChecklist.evidence: Targeted Vitest passed (3 files, 66 tests, 403ms); local matrix python-static-route passed with pythonStaticRouteState, route /health, expected body python-static-ok, strategy target-original-python-static-route-loader, and target response python-static-ok.

stopIf: Any proof would require claiming arbitrary process, VM, ELF, Node, Python, Go, Rust, or runtime cross-architecture restore.
Any proof requires source-ISA emulation instead of target-native continuation.
Any proof requires metadata-only success without visible target evidence.
Any proof requires baking proof-only packages into the base image instead of proof-local VM/overlay provisioning.
A support row cannot be narrowed to an explicit descriptor state, target loader strategy, and visible target proof output.
A gatekeeper row cannot prove refusal before target loader launch.
Required remote host root@192.168.0.8 is unreachable and remote amd64 evidence cannot be collected.
A proof row is disproved and cannot be narrowed into a safe envelope in this run.
